decisions.text: Score weights 40/35/25 (vibration/defects/yield); top_driver = highest unweighted percentile
Label = serious or critical defect within next 7 days
Git: local commits only, one commit per build step; export ZIP at end
Label = 11+ major/critical defects in next 7 days (worst ~10% of machine-weeks); replaces 'any serious defect'
Model: sklearn HistGradientBoosting (no PyPI on serverless); drivers = what-if (replace feature with typical training value), not SHAP
Label = machine in fleet's worst 10% by major/critical defects over next 7 days (relative, per day); replaces absolute 11+
App: rank by rule; model shown as second opinion (lift vs fleet average, what-if drivers) + rule-vs-model evidence panel
Attention weights 30/15/30/25 (vibration/temperature/defects/yield); temperature = abs change of 7d avg vs prior 7d, percentile within type
Genie chat as slide-out 'Ask the data' panel; space over 4 workshop_demo.manufacturing tables + machine_attention + machine_risk_7d
